Dear all

from 9th of September to 22th September there will be a DAAD (German Academic Exchange Service) Summer School on Spatial Ecotoxicology and Risk Assessment using an open community approach at the University Koblenz-Landau. The Summer School will be run exclusively using free open source software such as R, GRASS GIS, PostGIS.
See the course websites for further information:
https://www.daad.de/deutschland/studienangebote/international-programs/de/?p=d&s=sk&id=937
https://www.uni-koblenz-landau.de/landau/fb7/summeracademy?set_language=en

For participants from developing countries, there are scholarships that cover the complete course fees and travel costs. Hence, participants from ODA countries are especially encouraged to apply.

Best regards
Ralf
